title: Read a query value
summary: Gin: Read a query value. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: DefaultQuery reads a query parameter and supplies a fallback. GET /page uses the text fallback 1.
learningObjectives: Read a query value with Gin

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Read a query value

blocks.text: DefaultQuery reads no n value and uses the string 1. JSON therefore quotes it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Query values are strings, even when they look like numbers.
